description: Collision Lab remains an experiment/acceptance consumer rather than a second physics authority. The contract protects deterministic comparison work and representative browser/navigation experiments while production collision semantics remain in physics-engine.

scenarios.description: Compare broad-phase algorithms on the existing deterministic 3,000-object clustered scene.
correctnessEvidence: all algorithms produce identical candidate pair sets

scenarios.description: Browser/WASM comparison of per-agent A* and shared flow-field navigation using the same seeded 3D arena.
correctnessEvidence: navigation mode is the only global planning variable

metrics.name: planning_builds
metrics.notes: The browser comparison already exposes this deterministic counter; promote it to hosted smoke evidence once the WASM benchmark has a headless runner.

metrics.name: expanded_cells
metrics.notes: Deterministic browser counter; planned headless/Pages evidence boundary.

operations.description: Run every broad-phase algorithm on a fixed-density clustered family: copies of the deterministic 375-object clustered tile (seed 42, world extent 50, half extent 0.5; the density of the existing 3,000-object/extent-100 scenario) on a cubic lattice with a 125-unit pitch, cell size 2.5, fat margin 0.75.

objects.description: bodies in the scene: 375 per tile on a 1x1x1, 2x2x2, 3x3x3 and 4x4x4 tile lattice, so density stays constant

metrics.name: candidate-pairs
metrics.notes: Output size; identical for every algorithm and equal to the naive all-pairs oracle at every point (correctness gate). Exactly tiles x single-tile pairs.

metrics.name: uniform-grid-aabb-tests
metrics.notes: Grid candidates are local to shared cells, so work is exactly tiles x single-tile work; tests/work_complexity.rs asserts that exact multiple.

metrics.name: dynamic-aabb-tree-aabb-tests
metrics.notes: Self-traversal of the dynamic AABB tree (the retained algorithm); exactly tiles x single-tile work on this family.

metrics.name: static-bvh-aabb-tests
metrics.notes: Median-split static BVH is near-linear (n log n), not exactly proportional: the 3x3x3 lattice splits tiles unevenly. The shared vocabulary has no n log n bound, so the contract carries a budget that rejects all-pairs regression at every point; the Rust test also asserts tests <= n*ceil(log2 n)/2 at every point.

metrics.name: octree-aabb-tests
metrics.notes: OctreeBroadPhase::default() has a fixed max depth of 6, so leaf populations grow with world extent at fixed density and work is super-linear by design. Budget only; the Rust test also asserts it stays below 10% of all-pairs from 3,000 objects on.

metrics.name: sweep-and-prune-aabb-tests
metrics.notes: Single-axis sweep is output-sensitive in projected x-overlaps, which grow super-linearly on a 3D lattice. Budget only; the Rust test also asserts it stays below 10% of all-pairs from 3,000 objects on.

metrics.name: naive-aabb-tests
metrics.notes: Deliberately quadratic all-pairs comparison oracle: exactly n(n-1)/2, asserted in the Rust test. Its budget is n(n-1)/2 at 24,000 objects; this is the comparison role, not a lab failure.

operations.description: Simulation::interactions with the retained dynamic AABB tree over 8 frames after the preparation build, clustered scene at the density of the existing 3,000-object scenario (375*k^3 objects at world extent 50*k, seed 42), every body moving.

objects.description: bodies in the simulated scene, all dynamic

metrics.name: full-builds
metrics.notes: Full index builds after the preparation query; the retained tree must never rebuild per frame.

metrics.name: bodies-materialized
metrics.notes: Bodies copied into a temporary snapshot after preparation; the retained path never materializes the scene.

metrics.name: body-updates
metrics.notes: Exactly one retained update per moving body per frame (objects x 8).

metrics.name: reinsertions
metrics.notes: Updates whose body left its fat bounds; a subset of body updates.

operations.description: Zombie-arena 3D shared flow-field navigation (seed 5904189, 27x27 navigation grid, goal at the player cell): one preparation frame plus 20 frames of step_zombies at a fixed goal and topology.

agents.description: zombies following the shared field; arena grid, topology and goal stay fixed

metrics.name: planning-builds
metrics.notes: Shared flow-field builds including the preparation build: one, never one per agent.

metrics.name: expanded-cells
metrics.notes: Cells expanded by flow-field builds; depends on the grid and goal only. The budget is one full 27x27 grid expansion, so a second build fails it.

metrics.name: follow-lookups
metrics.notes: Agents that followed the shared field, summed over frames (agents x 21); per-agent follow work may grow linearly.

operations.description: After a prepared shared flow field, place one runtime barricade (topology change) and later move the goal; each change is followed by 20 frames of step_zombies.

agents.description: zombies following the shared field; arena grid, topology and goal stay fixed

metrics.name: topology-change-builds
metrics.notes: Exactly one legitimate rebuild after the barricade; at least one is enforced as correctness by the BFS oracle, at most one by this budget.

metrics.name: goal-change-builds
metrics.notes: Exactly one legitimate rebuild after the goal moves; at least one is enforced as correctness by the BFS oracle, at most one by this budget.
